The planet is depicted against a stark black background, which emphasizes its pale, off-white color and the intricate details of its rings. Planet (Saturn): Appearance: Saturn appears as a large, round sphere with a smooth surface. Its color is a light, creamy white, which is characteristic of its atmosphere. Rings: The most striking feature is the ring system surrounding Saturn. The rings are composed of countless small particles, primarily ice and rock,
